content.short: Dexter Lab provides real-time, historical, and raw block access for Solana data streams and storage.
content.description: Dexter Lab focuses on real-time and historical data infrastructure for the Solana ecosystem. It provides real-time data streams, ultra-fast data back-fillers, and archival RPC endpoints—including SVM Archival RPC—giving developers and analysts access to comprehensive Solana Virtual Machine data. This robust data layer underpins high-performance, data-intensive Solana applications by enabling live monitoring, precise analytics, and thorough debugging, while delivering reliable historical snapshots and low-latency streaming across on-chain activity.
